summary: Standing 100 ft Aermotor tower in Union County, MS, registered by NHLR in June 2022; the site includes County Forester accommodations; build date and visit access unknown.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor tower; site includes accommodations for the County Forester and outbuildings

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register 23 June 2022; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: Register lists a registration date and no site visit date
Register Description is the only narrative; no access or visitor statement
Site was previously thought to be the Center Lookout Tower
evidence.quote: The site was previously thought to be called the Center Lookout Tower.

evidence.supports: Forestry Commission signage confirmed the Union name
evidence.quote: The MFC signage confirmed that it's the Union Lookout Tower.

evidence.supports: 100 ft Aermotor and accommodations for the County Forester
evidence.quote: This site has a 100ft Aermotor tower and includes accommodations for the County Forester

evidence.supports: Residence, quonset hut, secondary shed and mechanics bay on the property
evidence.quote: There is a primary residence, a quonset hut, a secondary shed, and a mechanics bay located on the property.

evidence.supports: Administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
Forest Lookouts index files it as Center (Union), Union County
OpenStreetMap calls it the Center Lookout Tower
Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel
evidence.quote: Aermotor towers were made of galvanized steel

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the site was once thought to be the Center Lookout Tower and that commission signage confirmed Union. The Forest Lookouts index and OpenStreetMap still use Center. The story uses Union, the name on the register and signage.
The register gives 619 ft (189 m), which matches the brief's 188.7 m. OpenStreetMap gives 181 m. The story uses the register figure.

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry, the Forest Lookouts index (name and county only) and the OSM node were usable after two searches. No build date, staffing, fire history, visit or access information found. height_m is converted from the register's 100 ft. No access key set. The register names the County Forester accommodations but does not say the tower was built for that purpose, so the story does not say so. The other_names already include the Center names.
